div.head: Northu 2
div.ab: And Godes forboda we forbeodað, þæt ænig preost oðre cirican naðer ne gebicgæ ne geþicgæ, buton hine hwa mid heafodgilte forwyrce, þæt he weofodþenunge þanon forð wyrðe ne sy.
And Godes forbode, we forbeodað þæt ænig preost oðres cirican naðer ne gebicgæ ne geþicgæ, buton hine hwa mid heafodgilte forwyrce þæt he weofodþenunge þanon forð wyrðe ne sy.

Und kraft Gottes Verbot verbieten wir, dass irgend ein Priester eine[s?] andere[n] Kirche weder kaufe noch annehme, ausser wenn jener [andere Pfarrer] durch Capitalverbrechen sich schuldig macht, so dass er hinfort Altardienstes unwürdig sei.

And by God's prohibition we forbid that any priest should either buy or accept another's church, unless that [other priest] has forfeited himself by a capital crime, so that he is henceforth unworthy of altar-service.

And by virtue of God's prohibition we forbid that any priest shall either buy or receive another's church, unless anyone becomes guilty of a capital crime so that he is henceforth unworthy to minister at the altar.

And because of God’s prohibition, we forbid that any priest either buy or accept another’s church, unless the other ruins himself with a capital crime so that afterward he is unworthy to serve at the altar.
div.note: Some of Liebermann’s notes here are cut off in the gutter of the scan used, and are still to be completed.

‘oðre’ stands so in D; Thorpe conjectured ‘oðres’ (compare 2.2). D reads ‘gebicgæn’, ‘geþicgæn’ with a dot under the n. Liebermann compares the Canons of Edgar.; U: checked against Whitelock, EHD I (1979), and corrected (before: ‘And by virtue of God's prohibition, we forbid that any priest shall either buy or sell another's church, unless anyone becomes guilty of a capital crime so that he is henceforth unworthy to minister at the altar.’).; AY: corrected against Rabin p. 302 / 303, October 2026 (was “|”, now “∅”)
gebicgæ ne geþicgæ: gebicgæn ne geþicgæn with the final n in each gebicgæn marked out D

note.seg: -gæn, but with a dot under n

Nicht ‘als Sendbote’ (Thorpe, Schmid, Toller); ‘als’ bliebe nicht unausgedrückt; Sweet setzt ein Wort forboda nicht an; vgl. 61 denselben Anfang. Die Gesetze gebrauchen zum stilistischen Nachdruck oft den Namen Gottes; s. d. Gl 5a ff.—Die redenden ‘wir’ sind vermutlich der Bischof mit den Synodalen des Sprengels York

Not ‘as messenger’ (Thorpe, Schmid, Toller); ‘as’ would not be left unexpressed; Sweet does not posit a word forboda; cf. 61, the same opening. The laws often use the name of God for stylistic emphasis; see that word in Gl 5a ff. — The ‘we’ who speak are presumably the bishop with the members of the synod of the diocese of York

Nicht der Ämterkauf an sich wird getadelt (s. Geistliche 12), nur der zum Schaden anderer Pfarrer; s. u. 2, 2². Degradation oder Gefängnis droht dem, der Geld gibt zur Vertreibung eines Pfarrers und Erwerbung der Pfarre; Eccles. Instit. 474. Sine auctoritate episcoporum presbiteri non expellantur aus Fränk. Kapitular a. 816; Ps-Egbert Excerpt. 57, zitiert aus Theodor; vgl. ebd. 50. Dasselbe Verbot, nicht gegen Priester allein, u. 22

It is not the purchase of office as such that is censured (see Geistliche 12), only purchase to the detriment of other parish priests; see below 2, 2². Degradation or imprisonment threatens anyone who gives money for the expulsion of a parish priest and the acquisition of the parish; Eccles. Instit. 474. Sine auctoritate episcoporum presbiteri non expellantur, from a Frankish capitulary of 816; Ps-Egbert Excerpt. 57, quoted from Theodore; cf. ibid. 50. The same prohibition, not directed against priests alone, below 22
‘Kein Priester beraube den andern in dessen Kirche oder Pfarrsprengel’, Can. Edg. 9
‘No priest shall deprive another of his church or parish’, Can. Edg. 9
Nicht ‘ohne C. zu begehen’ mit Schmid, der hwa übersah
Not ‘without committing a C.’, with Schmid, who overlooked hwa
Vgl. Gl Geistliche 20. Keinen Altardienst darf der presbyter vitiatus capitalibus criminibus (heafodlicum gyltum) verrichten; Ps.-Egb. Poenit. III 2
Cf. Gl Geistliche 20. The presbyter vitiatus capitalibus criminibus (heafodlicum gyltum) may perform no service at the altar; Ps.-Egb. Poenit. III 2
